The '''Council of Reassignment''' was one of the four [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Councils]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in operation during the rule of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Reassignment Council met in the [[Reassignment Council Tower/Legends|northeast tower]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Overview==
The Council of Reassignment was made up of five [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] tasked with leading the [[Jedi Service Corps/Legends|Jedi Service Corps]] and the Councils that governed each branch. Meeting in the austere [[Reassignment Council Chamber|Council Chamber]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], membership on the Council was granted through appointment after a vote of all members. Two permanent members sat for life or until they stepped down, while the other three rotated out after serving a five [[Standard year/Legends|year]] term.<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

Leading the Service Corps meant monitoring [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] and their progress through the [[Jedi academy]]. If an Initiate failed to pass the [[Initiate Trials/Legends|Initiate Trials]] or [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] did not wish them to continue down the path of a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], the Council would step in and assign them to a branch of the Service Corps. Membership in the Corps was often viewed as a sign of weakness or failure; however, this was not the case. The Council would state that the work of the Corps aided galactic society just as a Knight would, however through use of other skills than wielding a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The Council also looked after [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] who failed the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]] or who were not selected for training by a Master. Membership was not restricted to those who failed out of the academy; the Council also assigned full-fledged Knights and Masters to serve a rotation with the Corps.<ref name="TJP" />

To assist in the operation of the Corps, the Reassignment Council organized four smaller satellite Councils to directly oversee each of the branches of the Corps. The [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]] was led by a [[Council of AgriCorps Masters|Council]] generally made up of [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] and [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]] while the [[Medical Corps/Legends|Medical Corps]] was led by the [[Circle of Jedi Healers/Legends|Circle of Healers]]. The [[Educational Corps]] was overseen by the [[Librarian's Assembly]] and the [[Chief Librarian/Legends|Chief Librarian]]; the [[Exploration Corps/Legends|Exploration Corps]] by [[Council of ExplorCorps Masters|several]] ranking masters.<ref name="TJP" />

The Reassignment Council existed nearly continuously throughout the history of the Order, right up until the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] when the Republic was dissolved and reorganized into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. With a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] at the helm of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], the Council was caught unaware when [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] issued [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and began the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. Following the [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|fall]] of the Jedi Temple, the members of the Council were hunted down and killed or else fled into self-imposed exile.<ref name="ROTS" />
